{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''YanYan Li''' (also stylized as Yanyan Li, Yan-yan Li, and Yan Yan Li) is a distinguished professor of mathematics at [[Rutgers University]], specializing in [[elliptic partial differential equation]]s.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://math.rutgers.edu/people/department-directory/detail/344-department-directory/1828-li-yanyan|title=Li, Yanyan|work=Department of Mathematics Directory|publisher=Rutgers University|access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref> He received his Ph.D. at [[New York University]] in 1988, under the direction of [[Louis Nirenberg]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|15606}}</ref> He joined Rutgers University in 1990.

Li was a Sloan Research Fellow from 1993 to 1995,  an invited lecturer at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2002,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathunion.org/icm-plenary-and-invited-speakers|title=ICM Plenary and Invited Speakers|publisher=International Mathematical Union|access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref> and is a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|publisher=American Mathematical Society|access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref>

== Major publications ==
* Yan Yan Li and Itai Shafrir. ''Blow-up analysis for solutions of ''{{math|−Δ''u'' {{=}} ''Ve<sup>u</sup>''}}'' in dimension two.'' Indiana Univ. Math. J. 43 (1994), no. 4, 1255–1270. {{doi|10.1512/iumj.1994.43.43054}} {{free access}}
* Yan Yan Li. ''Prescribing scalar curvature on {{math|S<sup>n</sup>}} and related problems. I.'' J. Differential Equations 120 (1995), no. 2, 319–410. {{doi|10.1006/jdeq.1995.1115}} {{free access}}
* Yan Yan Li. [https://sites.math.rutgers.edu/~yyli/Li96a.pdf ''Prescribing scalar curvature on {{math|S<sup>n</sup>}} and related problems. II. Existence and compactness.''] Comm. Pure Appl. Math. 49 (1996), no. 6, 541–597. {{doi|10.1002/(SICI)1097-0312(199606)49:6<541::AID-CPA1>3.0.CO;2-A}}
